Northern Uganda Heritage

Rooted in Gulu,
Revered Nationwide.

Established in 2003 on Acholi Road, Grace Christian High School was born out of an urgent regional conviction: that Northern Uganda deserved a secondary institution of uncompromising academic calibre rooted in Christian truth.

Today, our 12-acre campus accommodates over 1,200 scholars from across Acholi, Lango, and West Nile sub-regions. With fully equipped laboratory complexes, certified educators, and dedicated boarding accommodations, we set the benchmark for secondary education in Eastern Africa.

Fully UNEB Accredited

Direct testing centre for both UCE and UACE national examinations.

Holistic Boarding

Supervised dormitories, 24/7 security, and dedicated medical infirmary.

The Six Pillars of Grace Christian

Our graduates are distinguished by intellectual curiosity, moral fortitude, and active community responsibility.

01

Christian Character & Ethics

Forming young men and women of unyielding moral integrity, grounded in biblical leadership and servant service.

02

Academic Distinction

Mastery of the UNEB curriculum with rigorous laboratory practicals, daily tutorials, and continuous assessments.

03

STEM & Digital Readiness

Modern chemistry, physics, biology, and computer laboratories preparing future engineers, doctors, and technologists.

04

Regional Leadership

Empowering the next generation of civil, church, and entrepreneurial leaders for the transformation of Acholiland.

05

Discipline & Wholesome Boarding

A secure, serene, and structured residential environment fostering independence, brotherhood, and sisterhood.

06

Athletics & Cultural Arts

Competitive sports, regional debate champions, school choir, and creative arts nurturing well-rounded graduates.

National Curriculum

Comprehensive
O-Level & A-Level Tracks

Grace Christian High School strictly adheres to the UNEB national syllabus while integrating enrichment programmes in computer science, French, literature, and entrepreneurship.

Ordinary Level (S.1 – S.4)UCE Award

Compulsory sciences, mathematics, humanities, and languages with weekly practical laboratory tests.

Advanced Level Sciences (S.5 – S.6)UACE Award

Direct tracks into Medicine, Civil & Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, and Agriculture.

Advanced Level Arts & EconomicsUACE Award

Premier pathways for Law, Journalism, Banking & Finance, Education, and International Relations.
